12.
(1) The Board of Directors of the Corporation shall
cause proper accounts to be kept of all moneys received and
expended by the Corporation.
(2)  The  financial  year  of  the  Corporation  shall  be  the
calendar year.
(3) The accounts of the Corporation shall be examined
and  audited  at  least  once  in  every  year  by  an  auditor  or
auditors  being  a  member  of  the  Institute  of  Chartered
Accountants Sri Lanka appointed by the Board of Directors.

13.
The seal of the Corporation shall not be affixed to
any  instrument  whatsoever  except  in  the  presence  of  two
persons as may be provided for in the rules in force for the
time being of the Corporation, who shall sign their names to
the instrument in token of their presence and such singning
shall be independent of the signing of any person as a witness.

14.
Nothing  in  this  Act  contained  shall  prejudice  or
affect  the  rights  of  the  Republic  or  of  any  body  politic  or
corporate or of any other person except such as are mentioned
in this Act and those claiming by from or under them.

15.
In  the  event  of  any  inconsistency  between  the
Sinhala  and  Tamil  texts  of  this  Act,  the  Sinhala  text  shall
prevail.
